contacts.name: Captain Elias "Old Star" Voss
contacts.description:
Elias Voss was once a respected officer in the same secret Order as your character. He achieved the rank of Paladin (one step above Knight) before the Order’s internal purges during the Psionic Suppressions era. He faked his death and escaped 30 years ago, eventually settling on Theev where he built a new life as a respected (and feared) figure in Blacksand City.
He was the one who helped your character after he was freed from the shadow corporation — quietly pulling strings to get him discharged into the Army and later guiding him toward Theev when things got too hot. Voss sees your character as the son he never had — a reminder of what the Order should have been.

contacts.name: Seraphina "Sera" Morales (née Navarro)
contacts.description:
Enemy. Sera and Rafe met as young initiates in the Order and married after only two years of training. For the next four years they were a highly effective (and very public) power couple within the Order — known for daring missions that combined his teleportation and Awareness with her exceptional Clairvoyance and Telepathy.
Their marriage was passionate but volatile. It ended bitterly after four years due to growing ideological differences and the intense pressure of Order life. Rafe was starting to question the Order’s methods and secrecy, while Sera remained fiercely loyal. The divorce was messy and public within the Order’s circles. They parted as enemies.

background.soft_spots: Underdogs, young idealists, fellow fallen or disillusioned soldiers, and anyone who reminds him of who he used to be. He has a surprising soft spot for kids and stray animals.
background.good_traits: Loyal to the few people he lets in, surprisingly compassionate beneath the sarcasm, adaptable and calm under pressure, quick-witted, and genuinely skilled at what he does. Has a strong personal code even if he pretends he doesn’t.
background.most_at_ease: In a dimly lit spacer bar on Theev, pipe in hand, rifle nearby.
background.training_how: Allies/Contacts/Rivals/Enemies are on the Campaign Notes page
background.typical_mood: Laid-back, quietly amused, and easygoing with a hint of wry detachment. He carries himself like someone who has seen too much but refuses to let it ruin a good smoke.
background.greatest_joys: Quiet moments in a worn bunk with his pipe, a big gun across his lap, and no one shooting at him. Successfully teleporting out of impossible situations. Sharing a drink and stories with Old Star Voss.
background.training_when: He has a rugged but friendly square face, strong jaw, short messy military haircut with silver strands, and a distinctive handlebar mustache with a neatly trimmed short beard giving him roguish charm. Reflective mirror shades pushed slightly down his nose, revealing warm hazel eyes with a subtle playful psionic glow and a relaxed, amused smirk.
background.biggest_regret: Letting his marriage to Sera become toxic instead of walking away earlier. Not seeing the corruption in the Order sooner.
background.greatest_fears: Being captured and experimented on again. Losing control of his powers in a way that hurts innocent people. Becoming like the rigid, self-righteous Order he left behind.
background.darkest_secrets: He sometimes wonders if the Order was right about him — that he really is too undisciplined and dangerous to be trusted with psionics. He has never told anyone the full details of what the shadow corporation did to him during his imprisonment.
background.long_term_goals: Quietly build a small crew he can actually trust. Maybe one day expose or reform whatever is left of the corrupt elements in the Order of the White Star (without getting killed). Find some kind of personal peace — perhaps even make peace with Sera, or at least reach a real truce.
background.sense_of_humour: Dry, self-deprecating, and deadpan. Loves ironic observations about "knights," empires, and ex-wives. His humor is warm but sharp — he teases friends and enemies alike.
background.background_story:
Rafael Navarro was born on a dusty mid-tech world in the Trojan Reach. The son of a mechanic and a schoolteacher, he grew up fast, learning engines, guns, and how to talk his way out of trouble. At 18, his psionic powers erupted violently during a pirate raid on his hometown. Within weeks, agents of the secretive Order found him and conscripted him into their hidden ranks.

The Order trained him brutally but effectively. Navarro proved to be a natural — gifted with Awareness (especially Body Armour) and Teleportation. His calm nerves under fire and expert marksmanship with ballistic weapons made him a standout. Within four years he had risen rapidly and married fellow prodigy Seraphina "Sera" Vargas. For a while they were the golden couple of their cohort: cocky, effective, and deeply in love.

The marriage burned bright and crashed hard. Ideological cracks formed — Navarro increasingly questioned the Order’s secrecy, rigid hierarchy, and willingness to sacrifice individuals for “the greater good.” Sera remained a true believer. After four stormy years, their relationship ended in a bitter, public divorce that left deep scars on both sides.

Navarro threw himself deeper into the work. Over the next eight years he earned the rank of **Knight**, completing dozens of dangerous covert operations. Then, at age 30, everything fell apart. During a mission gone wrong, he was captured by a shadowy megacorporation that had been hunting psions for weaponization experiments. He spent nearly a year in brutal captivity — subjected to tests, drugs, and mental probing that pushed him to the edge.

Rescued by a fellow psion (rumored to be connected to Old Star Voss), Navarro returned to the Order expecting support. Instead, he faced suspicion and betrayal. Sera, still carrying the pain of their failed marriage, was among those who testified against him. Branded unreliable and tainted by his corporate imprisonment, he was formally **excommunicated**.

With nowhere left to turn, Navarro was drafted into the Imperial Army as a common infantryman. He served three more years as a highly effective (if insubordinate) marksman and special operations asset before mustering out. Drawn by rumors of freedom and opportunity, he eventually made his way to Theev.

Now 34, most people simply call him Navarro. He lives as a freelance operator and hired gun in Blacksand City. He spends his days taking odd jobs, smoking his chunky retro-futuristic pipe, and maintaining his oversized ballistic rifle. He’s found a gruff mentor and surrogate father in Elias "Old Star" Voss, the old Paladin turned fixer who helped him years ago.

Though he projects a laid-back, quirky spacer persona — mirror shades, handlebar mustache, dry humor, and all — Navarro is still haunted by his past. He carries the faded, defaced remnants of his service on his battered flak jacket, a constant reminder of what he once believed in… and what betrayed him.

He tries to live simply: good pay, good smokes, and staying one teleport jump ahead of trouble. But deep down, the fallen knight still wonders if he’ll ever find a cause worth fighting for again — or if he’ll simply keep drifting through the stars, pipe in hand and rifle across his lap.
background.short_term_goals: Secure enough credits for a reliable ship of his own (even a small beat-up scout or free trader). Find a steady, low-drama gig on Theev that pays well without too many moral compromises. Avoid any run-ins with Sera for at least a few months.
background.greatest_strength: Incredible mental resilience and battlefield creativity — combining teleportation, psychic armor, and expert marksmanship makes him extremely hard to pin down or kill in combat. His easygoing charm also helps him make friends in unlikely places.
background.general_description: He has a rugged but friendly square face, strong jaw, short messy military haircut with silver strands, and a distinctive handlebar mustache with a neatly trimmed short beard giving him roguish charm. Reflective mirror shades pushed slightly down his nose, revealing warm hazel eyes with a subtle playful psionic glow and a relaxed, amused smirk.
background.biggest_accomplishment: Rising to the rank of Knight in the Order through skill and willpower despite starting as a scared 18-year-old conscript.

characters.name: Gareth Voss
characters.notes: Gareth Voss is a 34-year-old human former Imperial Army Special Forces operator from Byzantium. Combining technical expertise with battlefield experience, he now travels the Imperium as an independent contractor and problem solver. Quietly dependable and intensely loyal, Gareth strives to protect those around him while carrying the burden of past failures that continue to shape his decisions.

augments.name: Wafer Jack
augments.notes: Wafer Jack (TL 12): A wafer jack is a computer system implanted into the base of the skull that consists of an external data socket and a processor running an interface program. A character with a wafer jack can use expert programs for tasks relying on Intelligence or Education only. The main benefit of the jack is that it is much smaller and more discrete than a hand computer, and the user can access the expert program by thought alone. A wafer jack is a Computer/2 (Computer/4 at TL 13) and can only run expert programs. It is always running Intelligent Interface at no cost. Cr. 10,000. (Cr. 15,000 at TL 13.)

session_journal.session_name: Session 0.5 - Buying all the things. Meeting the King. The Pirate's Life for Me.
session_journal.content:
Hired to protect products. Borrowed a ship, the Echo. During last run, caught and targetted via the Imperium. Lost the ship (blew it up to escape, killing Imperials), lost the cargo. Now we have a heft bounty on our heads. 

While in hiding, contacted by a Sol D'Cant. King Drinax needs a favor. Daughter contacted Sol. 

Kyle almost dies. Capt. Troc gives us Cr3K

Meeting the king. Call him Olbed in private. Letters of Marque to pray on ships within the borders of the former Sindal empire. Map of Imperium and Aslan territory. We're to take the Harrier and cut a bloody swath across the area. Bleed merchants, don't start a war. Make the worlds our allies. Defend against raiders. GOAL: Give King leverage to get advantage over Imperium. If it works, we become Dukes; someone marries his daughter. 

Contacts:
* Capt. Troc (Aslan)
